I edited `apps/react-vite/vite.config.ts` to add the vendor and query chunks and turn on production source maps. I did not run the build, because it needs approval I couldn't get in this session.

The change is in the `build` block:
- **`sourcemap: true`** is set on `build`, so production builds emit `.map` files.
- **`manualChunks`** is an object with two entries:
  - `vendor`: `react`, `react-dom` and `react-router`.
  - `query`: `@tanstack/react-query`.

One deviation from your request: the app depends on `react-router` (v7), not `react-router-dom`, and nothing imports the latter. I used `react-router` in the vendor chunk. If you meant to add `react-router-dom` as well, it would be a one-line addition.

I did not run tests, lint or the app. Nothing is committed.

To check the result, run `yarn build` from `apps/react-vite` and look for `vendor-*.js` and `query-*.js` in `dist/assets`, plus `.map` files next to the bundles.
